name: Istfell
aliases: the realm of the ignoble dead
description: The Kaldheim afterlife of the ignoble dead not worthy of Starnheim.

timeline.summary: The harness triggers runic magic that pulls the Hall from the Gods' Realm into the roots of the World Tree; Valki has vanished.
timeline.quote: Toralf's mighty strength had triggered the runic magic, which pulled the Hall from the Gods' Realm to the bottom of the World Tree

citation.text: "Gods' Hall", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The gods' halfhearted efforts to move the Hall back are hindered by magic seeping from the World Tree.
timeline.quote: The gods keep saying they should move it back to the Gods' Realm

citation.text: "Gods' Hall", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ranar wakes as a spirit on an endless tundra with arrows in his chest and realizes he is dead.
timeline.quote: Ranar opened his eyes to find himself in an inglorious place.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar remembers dying in battle against demon raiders after seeing the last of his children to safety (flashback).
timeline.quote: A pile of demonic dead, and Ranar's duty complete.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar realizes the Valkyries have judged him to Istfell instead of Starnheim and resolves to prove his worth there.
timeline.quote: Without horror, he realized he was in an afterlife unexpected: Istfell.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar throws his axe to choose his direction and sets off walking.
timeline.quote: The haft pointed the way.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar sees the wolf at the end of the world, decides not to fight it, and salutes it as it leaves.
timeline.quote: Ranar raised his axe above his head in quiet salute

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: A withered spirit warns Ranar of the cairn-eaters, who tear down a monument built as tribute to Egon.
timeline.quote: I realized for EGON this tribute, and my reward was the hatred of these most lost souls

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar finds demons guarding a river of marching spirits and refuses their order to move on.
timeline.quote: These were not spirits but demons of some kind.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar kills both demon guards with his axe.
timeline.quote: The strength of Ranar's swing threw the demon away from the column, where it landed with a heavy thud on the ground, dead.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The river of freed spirits tells Ranar they are free and then dissolves into mist.
timeline.quote: the entirety of it began to drift into mist

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar reaches the gates and bridge of Istfell and waits there for centuries as guardian.
timeline.quote: He had followed his axe and could go no farther.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: A living-looking youth appears on the bridge and introduces himself as Bjorn of Beskir, asking Ranar's help on a quest.
timeline.quote: My name is Bjorn of Beskir, and I am not supposed to be here

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar accepts the quest and feels life begin to return to him.
timeline.quote: Life, distant, nevertheless had begun to fill him like liquid fills a vessel.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Bjorn reveals he means to climb a tower built by his ancestors and cut open a passage to Starnheim, and orders Ranar to follow.
timeline.quote: Now I will climb it, and with this sword cut open a passage to Starnheim.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar and Bjorn cut through the Elk King's guard and Bjorn kills the Elk King, taking his crown.
timeline.quote: He plunged his dagger into the spirit's neck and levered him to the floor.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Bjorn explains that he must slay three kings, the crow next and the bear last, to open Starnheim.
timeline.quote: We take the crow next, and last the bear, and then Starnheim opens to me.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar's hands become whole and flesh-colored as the kills restore life to him.
timeline.quote: His hands, once the faded green of spiritflesh, were made whole.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The wolf at the end of the world returns and watches the two leave the Elk King's keep.
timeline.quote: The wolf at the end of the world had returned from its wandering.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar and Bjorn fight the Feather Guard at the Crow King's perch and Ranar cuts the Crow King down.
timeline.quote: before Ranar landed a mortal blow with his axe, sending the Crow King to the ground

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Bjorn stabs the wounded Crow King, and the city's people vanish.
timeline.quote: Bjorn plunged his sword into the Crow King's belly.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar finds the city empty and begins to suspect Bjorn's quest is wrong.
timeline.quote: The city below was empty.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar realizes Bjorn killed his own kin and came to Istfell on purpose; Bjorn replies that he makes his own fate.
timeline.quote: You did this on purpose, didn't you?

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: At the foot of the Bear King's tower they find a mummified body speared with a banner reading CLIMB.
timeline.quote: Unraveled, it had a single word painted upon it: CLIMB.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar and Bjorn reach the roof and face the Bear King and his Ursan Guard, who say they guard Istfell from threats within and without.
timeline.quote: Ranar and Bjorn stood before the Bear King and his final Ursan Guard.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Together they slay the Ursan Guard.
timeline.quote: Together they slew the Ursan Guard.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Bjorn lets the Bear King's swing land on Ranar, breaking his axe and wounding him.
timeline.quote: Bjorn slid under the king's opening swing, leaving Ranar to take the blow.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Bjorn cuts the Bear King's leg and drives his sword into the king's chest.
timeline.quote: Bjorn drove his sword up through a layer of the Bear King's mail and into his chest.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Bjorn sheds his disguise and is revealed as Egon, god of the dead.
timeline.quote: In his place stood the very lord of Istfell himself, Egon, god of the dead

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Egon beheads the Bear King with his scythe.
timeline.quote: Egon pressed the king forward into the blade of his scythe.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Egon opens a rent into Starnheim, showing the golden realm.
timeline.quote: Starnheim was open before them.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The Valkyrie Firja arrives and seals the rent, refusing Egon entry.
timeline.quote: The light of Starnheim vanished, the rent in the cosmos sealed shut.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Firja tells Egon he must remain in Istfell.
timeline.quote: You will remain in Istfell.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar offers Firja his broken axe and asks to keep guarding; she grants it and the axe is repaired with Valkyrie metal.
timeline.quote: Ranar stood, marveling as his axe repaired itself in his hands.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: At Firja's command, Ranar strikes down Egon with one blow.
timeline.quote: he swung his axe, striking down the God of Death in a single blow.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Firja explains Egon will return to his throne in time and that Ranar has played this part in a cycle many times.
timeline.quote: You are an integral part of this cycle.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Firja tells Ranar to serve the realm well and flies into Starnheim's light.
timeline.quote: Serve this realm and its people well, Ranar of Istfell.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar returns to spirit form, throws his repaired axe, and sets off to guard Istfell.
timeline.quote: Alone, the guardian of Istfell pulled his axe free and set off toward the far horizon.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Ranar refuses to abandon his post, protects and trains the children, then lets the Valkyries take him and is named guardian of Istfell.
timeline.quote: They named him the guardian of Istfell

citation.text: "Ranar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Firja commands Ranar to kill Egon and names Ranar guardian of the pass; the cycle will repeat as Ranar forgets.
timeline.quote: Firja commanded Ranar to kill Egon so that the god would return to the Cosmos

citation.text: "Ranar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Egon is the lord of Istfell.
relations.quote: In his place stood the very lord of Istfell himself, Egon, god of the dead

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.

relations.quote: he proclaims himself the Lord High Ruler of the Lands of Istfell

citation.text: "Egon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: The Gods' Hall is a grand structure located in the realm of Istfell on the plane of Kaldheim .

citation.text: "Gods' Hall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

pages_say.description: The afterlife of those who lived mundane lives, a pale green tundra and cairn-strewn realm beneath the roots of the World Tree.

citation.text: "Direction. Purpose. Honor. Glory." by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2021.
